title: The support of an effective relative cycle is closed
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（33 行证明）、有效相对循环的支撑闭性：约化到积分基（effective-functoriality 加 support-family 两具名引理）、DVR 实现 specialization（Properties 引理）、DVR 情形正系数加 Varieties 维度引理推出支撑等于一般支撑闭包。4 处引用全具名（含被拒卡 effective-functoriality 作 stub 引用），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-effective-support-closed (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1936-1943

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to integral base using functoriality of effectivity and the support behaviour under families of morphisms, then reduce further along a discrete valuation ring realizing the specialization from the generic point to any given point using the Properties lemma, and in the valuation ring case write the generic fibre as a positive combination of integral cycles, compute the closed fibre as the positive combination of the fibres of their closures which are equidimensional of the right dimension by the Varieties dimension lemma, so the support of the closed fibre is the fibre of the closure of the generic support, giving that the whole support is the closure of the generic support and hence closed (source lines 1945-1977)
